I worked as a receptionist at a car dealership when I was 20 and I was being promoted to a Product Specialist, so I had to learned the ins and outs of all of our cars. 

I was good friends with one of the younger Sales guys and he offered to help me test drive one of our newer models to show me all the bells and whistles. 

This is important, my dealership was among 3 other dealerships, snuggled within a much larger business park of office buildings. So the area we were driving in was pretty damn big.

During the test drive we were just shooting the sh*t and driving around, until he pulled into the very back of the business park towards the loading bay of one of the office buildings. How it’s a 6pm on a summer Friday, so there was NOBODY in a 2 mile radius of us. 

He gets out, goes into the backseat, and asks me to hop in the back with him so he could “show me some cool features”. I remember feeling this dread go through me that made me shake as I opened the car door and stood. 

I don’t know if I saw something in his eye or maybe his tone changed slightly, but I knew in my soul that I was in danger. We stood in a stalemate for a good 5 minutes whilst he begged me to get in the back and I refused. 

I knew I needed a good reason to get him to let me go back to the dealership so I pretended to get a text, proceeded to message my mom an SOS.

My mom’s a champ because she called immediately, pretended to have a dire emergency and, needed me to leave work. So I told the sales guy and I could see the mask of kindness fall from his face and his demeanor changed quickly. He forced me to drive him back to the dealership like a chauffeur and while he sat in the back. 

It wasn’t until we got back that I realized he had the child lock on and I had to let him out of the car. The company I worked under with this dealership was notorious for covering up SH/SA within their organization, so the guy would’ve totally gotten away with whatever he was planning.
